Resolves #18691
Refs #17844

`WorkstationTabRestoreNL` reaches its gesture again. Its readiness gate compared every rendered `.neo-tab-header-toolbar` against the committed `tabs` nodes, and the dock's edge-rail reveal overlay renders a real `tab.header.Toolbar` of its own — so two hidden overlays read as tab bars, the count never converged, and the arm spent its full sixty-second timeout without ever driving the drag it exists to prove.
- The count is scoped to the dock's own tab containers, so a reveal overlay can neither satisfy nor break it.
- The poll returns both sides as text, so a mismatch names them. The old message — "every committed tabs node must have a rendered header" — asserted the opposite of what was happening and sent me hunting for an absent header.

Evidence: L3 achieved — the arm runs against the external Brain runtime in both launch modes, plus a mutation → L3 required, since no CI workflow runs this Neural Link spec. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Red-first: on dev the gate reads `8 rendered / 6 committed` at rest, stable across six poll samples, and the arm fails on the 60s timeout in isolation as well as inside the 281-test battery (red at `3044d7f86b` and `28584754ff`). With the fix it passes in 3.9s headless and 3.5s headed. |
| AC-2 | The failure message names both sides. Under the AC-4 mutation it reads `Received string: "5 rendered / 6 committed"` against the expected equal-count pattern. |
| AC-3 | The gesture now runs and the arm's own assertions decide the result: it passes in both modes, so nothing further was hiding behind the blind gate. Recorded on the ticket. |
| AC-4 | Mutation: remove one rendered dock header before the poll. The gate fails with `5 rendered / 6 committed`; reverted with `git restore`, tree clean at `1b8fdf9bc1`. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The scope is positive — count within the dock tab containers — rather than excluding `.neo-dashboard-dock-reveal-header` by name. A future non-dock tab header then cannot reintroduce the same failure.
- The equal-count pattern also refuses zero on both sides, so a selector that matched nothing fails instead of passing vacuously.
- The reveal overlay's provenance is in the commit body rather than the source comment: `check-ticket-archaeology` refuses tracking refs in durable comments, and it caught my first attempt.

## Test Evidence
- `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<neo-agent-brain> NEO_E2E_PORT=8163 npx playwright test 'workstation/WorkstationTabRestoreNL\.spec' -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1`: 1 passed (3.9s).
- The same with `--headed`, the mode the #17844 census runs: 1 passed (3.5s).
- Instrumented at rest on dev, six identical samples: `tabsNodes 6 [scale-tabs, heavy-tabs, left-tabs, right-top-tabs, right-bottom-tabs, bottom-tabs]` against `bars 8`, two of them empty. The first surplus bar named from the DOM: `neo-dashboard-dock-reveal-header neo-tab-container-inline neo-tab-header-toolbar neo-toolbar`, inside `neo-dashboard-dock-rail-1`, hidden at 0×0.
- Mutation receipt above.
